new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/run_embedded_test.jl
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+using Ferrite
+using Tensors
+using Test
+using LinearAlgebra
+using StaticArrays
+
+include("test/test_utils.jl")
+
+# Run only the EmbeddedLineFacetValues testset
+println("Running EmbeddedLineFacetValues testset...")
+
+@testset "EmbeddedLineFacetValues" begin
+
+    for dim in (2, 3)
+        for (order, ct) in zip((1, 2), (Line, QuadraticLine))
+            grid = generate_grid(ct, (1,), zero(Vec{dim}), 1.2 * ones(Vec{dim}))
+            transform_coordinates!(grid, x -> x + basevec(x)[1] * norm(x)^2) # Make geometry nonlinear
+            ip = Lagrange{RefLine, order}()
+            ip_geo = Lagrange{RefLine, order}()^dim
+
+            dξ = 1.0e-6
+            ξ = Vec{1}.([(-1.0,), (-1.0 + dξ,), (1.0 - dξ,), (1.0,)])
+            qr = QuadratureRule{RefLine}(fill(NaN, 4), ξ)
+
+            cv = CellValues(qr, ip, ip_geo)
+            cell_coords = Ferrite.getcoordinates(grid, 1)
+            reinit!(cv, cell_coords)
+
+            fqr = FacetQuadratureRule{RefLine}(1)
+            fv = FacetValues(fqr, ip, ip_geo)
+
+            # Facet 1
+            reinit!(fv, cell_coords, 1)
+            x1 = spatial_coordinate(cv, 1, cell_coords)
+            x2 = spatial_coordinate(cv, 2, cell_coords)
+            @assert norm(x1 - spatial_coordinate(fv, 1, cell_coords)) < 1.0e-14 # Handle x ≈ 0
+            @test getnormal(fv, 1) ≈ normalize(x1 - x2) atol = 1.0e-6
+
+            # Facet 2
+            reinit!(fv, cell_coords, 2)
+            x3 = spatial_coordinate(cv, 3, cell_coords)
+            x4 = spatial_coordinate(cv, 4, cell_coords)
+            @assert x4 ≈ spatial_coordinate(fv, 1, cell_coords)
+            @test getnormal(fv, 1) ≈ normalize(x4 - x3) atol = 1.0e-6
+        end
+    end
+
+    # Test unknown facet error path as its not yet tested in "test_quadrules.jl"
+    @test_throws ArgumentError Ferrite.weighted_normal(zero(SMatrix{2, 1}), RefLine, 3)
+end
+
+println("\n✓ All EmbeddedLineFacetValues tests passed!")

+++ b/src/FEValues/facet_integrals.jl
@@ -88,6 +88,20 @@ function weighted_normal(::Tensor{2, 1, T}, ::Type{RefLine}, facet::Int) where {
     throw(ArgumentError("unknown facet number"))
 end
 
+
+# For embedded line elements in 2D space
+function weighted_normal(J::SMatrix{2, 1, T}, ::Type{RefLine}, facet::Int) where {T}
+    facet == 1 && return Vec{2}(-J[:, 1])
+    facet == 2 && return Vec{2}(J[:, 1])
+    throw(ArgumentError("unknown facet number"))
+end
+
+# For embedded line elements in 3D space
+function weighted_normal(J::SMatrix{3, 1, T}, ::Type{RefLine}, facet::Int) where {T}
+    facet == 1 && return Vec{3}(-J[:, 1])
+    facet == 2 && return Vec{3}(J[:, 1])
+    throw(ArgumentError("unknown facet number"))
+end

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a605256
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test_fix.jl
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+using Ferrite
+using StaticArrays
+using Test
+
+println("Testing weighted_normal for embedded line elements...")
+
+# Test 2D line
+J2d = SMatrix{2, 1}([1.0, 2.0])
+n1_2d = Ferrite.weighted_normal(J2d, RefLine, 1)
+n2_2d = Ferrite.weighted_normal(J2d, RefLine, 2)
+@test n1_2d == Vec{2}((-1.0, -2.0))
+@test n2_2d == Vec{2}((1.0, 2.0))
+println("✓ 2D line weighted_normal works")
+
+# Test 3D line  
+J3d = SMatrix{3, 1}([1.0, 2.0, 3.0])
+n1_3d = Ferrite.weighted_normal(J3d, RefLine, 1)
+n2_3d = Ferrite.weighted_normal(J3d, RefLine, 2)
+@test n1_3d == Vec{3}((-1.0, -2.0, -3.0))
+@test n2_3d == Vec{3}((1.0, 2.0, 3.0))
+println("✓ 3D line weighted_normal works")
+
+# Test invalid facet throws ArgumentError
+@test_throws ArgumentError Ferrite.weighted_normal(zero(SMatrix{2, 1}), RefLine, 3)
+println("✓ Invalid facet number throws ArgumentError")
+
+println("\nAll weighted_normal tests passed!")
